quest.title: Strange Stone Chronicle
quest.description: In order to find Puca's token, you once again visit the vein from before...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000, Strange Part x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Puca, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon! Are you here to play with me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, not really! You told us that we could ask you anything related to ore veins and gemstones, right?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yep! I've collected all the pretty stones around the area. What exactly do you wanna ask about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's about that stone we found last time...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Puca about how you sold the strange ore to the gemstone merchant...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Huh? People outside really thought that it was a precious gemstone? But I've even shown it to my sister before... Humans really are hard to understand...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: But I know a lot of places with stones like this! If you want, I'll show you where they are.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Puca marks the locations of the strange ore on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That'll be great. Thanks, Puca! Oh, right, here's the Mora that Chesil paid us as an advance fee. We could give you half, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Oh, it's alright. We don't really need anything like that in the village, anyway... not to mention how you've helped me so much, too!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Welcome... Oh hey, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Do you have the ore you agreed to bring?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Well, the craftsmen are still processing the previous sample, so it's not too urgent...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: But if we managed to get our hands on more supplies, the craftsmen might just become newly inspired, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I'll still be here waiting for your good news.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Welcome! We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: The ore you brought last time is still being processed at the moment, so I cannot show you the finished product yet. I'm afraid you must wait a bit longer...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Whoa, you found so much... This is an enormous help!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I already sent the ore to the workshop, but I still haven't received my sample product yet. It could be because the artisans aren't familiar with working a gem of this kind and ran into some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: But worry not! I trust my judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I'm planning to turn them into accessories that'll no doubt become the newest craze all across Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: You'll see what the final product looks like the next time you visit! I'll give you some samples as a gift when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Or perhaps... you might see the most fashionable of the nobility wearing them before you even arrive, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Alright then, you're always welcome to come back another time.

talks.objective: Take the ore you've gathered to Chesil

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Welcome... Oh hey, it's you! My gemstone suppliers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! We brought lots of that ore, as promised!
